verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a distributed mode with horizontal scaling, where GPU worker nodes self-register with a frontend coordinator. That is a plausible way to add capacity for concurrent load. Nothing in the evidence shows reserved or dedicated capacity, or steady throughput under concurrent sessions. Missing for 10: capacity reservation or per-session/agent resource allocation, parallel request handling or batching settings, throughput-under-concurrency benchmarks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
